payload.reason: The evidence provides clear demonstrations of the interpretability merits of the approach through empirical results and the methodology used for keyword discovery and expectation estimation.

claims.text: The approach improves model training transparency by soliciting informative keywords from the crowd, providing human-understandable explanations for model improvements.
Empirical results show significant performance improvements, indicating that the approach effectively enhances model interpretability and accuracy.
The method leverages disagreement between the model and crowd to discover informative keywords, enhancing interpretability by revealing how the model learns.
